About Revolut
 People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
 About The Role
 Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.
We’re looking for a skilled Platform Engineer with experience building applications for iOS devices. You'll help design, build, and evolve the foundational tools, frameworks, and infrastructure that power our frontend applications.
Whatever you ship at this layer ends up being used across the company, so a small improvement can save a lot of time for the team.
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
 What You'll Be Doing
Designing, developing, and maintaining reusable components, libraries, frameworks, and foundational tools that support iOS application development
Building tools, automation, and workflows that simplify local development, testing, debugging, and release processes for frontend and mobile engineers
Contributing to architectural decisions that improve modularity, maintainability, scalability, and consistency across iOS applications
Defining and implementing elegant solutions to interesting problems
Helping to define and maintain visual guidelines, ensuring consistency throughout the app
Establishing and promoting best practices around code quality, testing, observability, reliability, and maintainable software design
 What You'll Need
7+ years of experience in iOS development
A bachelor's degree in computer science, maths, physics, or a similar field
Experience releasing iOS apps via the App Store, TestFlight, and enterprise distribution channels
Expertise in building and maintaining iOS applications using technologies and tools like Swift, UIKit, SwiftUI, and Xcode
Familiarity with Swift and the iOS SDK for native app development
Experience collaborating with design and backend teams using UI/UX tools, like Figma, and integrating REST or GraphQL APIs
An active GitHub account
At least one published app available to download in an app store
 Nice to have
A background in fintech or other high-volume transactional environment
Experience in a startup or scale-up
Experience leading engineering teams and driving technical delivery to ensure high-quality, timely project outcomes
Experience mentoring, onboarding, and guiding developers, while sharing best practices and supporting team growth
 Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.
 Important notice for candidates:
 Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
 Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
 Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.
 We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.
